- A material change in company fundamentals (quarterly earnings, revenue, earnings per share)
- A material change in company structure (change in ownership, stock composition, business model)

You can't just watch the market. You must use your position to buy or sell securities.

Penalties vary by jurisdiction. In the U.S., it's a felony (up to 10 years in prison and fines).
